title: Senior Business TA Manager
description: At Applike Group, we don’t just "fill roles"; we engineer the future of our high-growth portfolio companies. As a Senior Business TA Manager, your mission is to act as a talent engineer for our fastest-growing company, adjoe, in the Americas. You will navigate the landscape to find the best go-to-market talent, ensuring adjoe has the capabilities to remain market leader. This position calls for a strategic talent partner who excels at navigating go-to-market strategies and advising business leaders on securing top talent to drive ongoing success. The applike group is committed to creating engaging experiences for every app user around the world. We are passionate about creating market-changing products, technologies, and companies. We have already founded 4 companies. Our ventures are independent business units that benefit from each other’s technologies, expertise, and market access to become even more successful: adjoe is developing a breakthrough mobile advertising solution that enables app publishers around the world to grow their advertising revenues. justDice is the market leader in Mobile Gaming Loyalty Programs. Sunday is a next-generation hybrid casual mobile game publisher. And justtrack offers unique software to automate the entire mobile user acquisition process. Yet more to come. Under the umbrella of the media company Bertelsmann , we have access to a global network of experts and strong financial support. By developing a state-of-the-art tech stack and highly skilled workforce, we aim to reach more mobile users than any other company in the world. If you want to grow your career in tech, challenge yourself in a high-performance environment, while having fun with great colleagues from all over the world, you've come to the right place! Find the whole world in one office. Boost your career with awesome people! What you will do: 1. Stakeholder Management You are a peer to our MDs, VPs of Sales, and Founders. You don't just take orders; you provide high-level talent advisory. Leverage our internal Talent Intelligence team for deep industry data and competitive mapping to guide leadership on hiring feasibility and organizational design. Drive the hiring process by aligning role requirements with business goals, ensuring every hire moves the needle for the company’s bottom line. Act as the critical link between complex go-to-market plans and the human capital needed to execute them. 2. Talent Engagement The best talent isn't looking for a job; you are the one who finds them. Use creative networking to track down talent across the Americas. Craft bespoke outreach strategies that resonate with senior go-to-market talent, selling the vision of the group’s existing success stories. Partner with our internal teams to manage the seamless relocation and integration of hires into our local hubs across the Americas. 3. AI Workflow We believe the future of recruiting is hybrid. We don't expect you to be an AI researcher, but we expect you to be fearless with the tech. Be exceptionally comfortable utilizing existing AI-driven sourcing and screening tools to maximize your output. Participate in the experimentation and "building" of new internal AI workflows to keep our TA engine at the absolute cutting edge. Who you are: Experience: 7+ years of total recruiting experience in SaaS or Technology, with a minimum of 2+ years specifically as a Senior Business Recruiter working on high-visibility, high-impact roles. Background: Ideally, you have an agency or go-to-market background. Mindset: You treat sourcing like a research project. You are relentless in your pursuit of talent. Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to high-level stakeholders. Adaptability: You thrive in an environment where performance is measured by impact, not activity. You value feedback and constant iteration. Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions Invest in Your Future : You’ll join a high-performing, rapidly scaling global company with a clear vision, while directly influencing the company’s trajectory and sharing in its success. We’re committed to your growth through regular feedback, mentoring, and our development programs. You’ll expand your skillset and build a long-term career at adjoe. Easy Arrival to adjoe : From signing to settling in Boston, we’ve got you and your family covered, including a relocation package and personal support to help you build your life here, making your move smooth and stress-free. Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond : Flexible hours, remote Fridays, and 30 vacation days. You’ll also have three weeks of remote work each year, wellness reimbursement, and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Future & Financial Health Package : Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K match program. Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it ! Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application! We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
description: 🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust. About SE3 SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence. Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads. About the Role As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer , you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy. This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team. The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better. What You’ll Work On Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system. Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows. Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized. Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system. Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable. Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab. Your Profile Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches. You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field. You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems. You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines. You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage. You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe. You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab. You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination. Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation. Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field. Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy. Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures. Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows. Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge. 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

segmentation&nbsp;(VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across&nbsp;Officeand&nbsp;DMZ&nbsp;networks with clear trust boundaries.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2) Routing, Switching, WLAN &amp; Regional Sites</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineer&nbsp;BGP/OSPF&nbsp;for WAN &amp; DC; deliver&nbsp;redundancy/failover&nbsp;across carriers and sites.</li> <li>Own&nbsp;Aruba&nbsp;campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).</li> <li>Plan and execute&nbsp;site builds/moves/expansions&nbsp;(circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3) Security, Remote Access &amp; Identity</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;FortiGate&nbsp;policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and&nbsp;FortiGate VPN&nbsp;(IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.</li> <li>Implement&nbsp;802.1X NAC&nbsp;(e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with&nbsp;RADIUS/Active Directory&nbsp;integration; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>5) Reliability, Observability &amp; Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver&nbsp;high availability&nbsp;(fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested&nbsp;DR/failover.</li> <li>Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g.,&nbsp;Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and&nbsp;capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.</li> <li>Centralize logging with&nbsp;rsyslog&nbsp;and&nbsp;FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.</li> <li>Use&nbsp;NetBox,&nbsp;Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for&nbsp;configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6) Compliance, Risk &amp; Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Map network controls to <strong>TISAX</strong>&nbsp;expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).</li> <li>Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on <strong>risk assessments, controls testing</strong>, and <strong>evidence</strong>&nbsp;preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).</li> <li>Manage <strong>carriers and vendors</strong>&nbsp;(Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.</li> <li>Mentor regional IT; act as <strong>L3 escalation</strong>&nbsp;for incidents and major changes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security &amp; Remote Access:&nbsp;FortiGate&nbsp;NGFW,&nbsp;FortiGate VPN&nbsp;(IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.</li> <li>Campus/Branch &amp; WLAN:&nbsp;Aruba&nbsp;CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs,&nbsp;ClearPass&nbsp;(802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).</li> <li>Data Center &amp; Automation:&nbsp;Zabbix,&nbsp;rsyslog&nbsp;(retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow;&nbsp;Ansible/Python, Git.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in&nbsp;enterprise on‑prem networking&nbsp;across&nbsp;multi‑site/multi‑region&nbsp;environments.</li> <li>Deep hands‑on with&nbsp;FortiGate,&nbsp;Aruba&nbsp;(switching/WLAN),&nbsp;Dell&nbsp;data‑center switching, and&nbsp;NVIDIA InfiniBand&nbsp;basics.</li> <li>Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.</li> <li>Proven delivery of&nbsp;secure remote access,&nbsp;802.1X NAC, and&nbsp;logging/monitoring&nbsp;at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).</li> <li>Experience aligning network controls to&nbsp;ISMS/TISAX&nbsp;(policy ↔ design ↔ evidence).</li> <li>Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Certifications:&nbsp;Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or&nbsp;NVIDIA networking.</li> <li>ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity.</li> <li>Exposure to&nbsp;RADIUS/AD&nbsp;integration and&nbsp;FreeRADIUS&nbsp;stack.</li> <li>Familiarity with&nbsp;Zabbix&nbsp;tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling.</li> <li>Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 class="TranslationField-module__fieldItemName___Q0F_7 TranslationField-module__aboutUsWrapper___WXJpq"><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <div>A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.</div> </li> <li> <div>Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.</div> </li> <li> <div>Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.</div> </li> <li> <div>Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.</div> </li> <li> <div>Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.</div> </li> <li> <div>Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks &amp; fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment</div> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><strong>Agile Robots</strong> is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet. You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software. Your Day-to-Day As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution: Edge Infrastructure Ownership Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services. Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs. Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues. Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes. Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field. Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice. Architecture, Collaboration & Craft Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing. Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority. Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues. Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment. Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product. Your Experience and Skills Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines. Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python . Monitoring : Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Terraform is a native language to you. Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware , including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting . DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD. Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN). What Makes You Stand Out Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise : Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules . Bare-Metal Automation : Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning. Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect : Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery : Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments. Behavioral competencies Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability. Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in. High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value. Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution. Fit to Our Values We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty. We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving. We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. title: Senior Solutions Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Role:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span></p> <p>Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.</p> <p>You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.</p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Data integration and ingestion:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement standard extractors. </strong>Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.</li> <li><strong>Build custom API connectors. </strong>Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.</li> <li><strong>Enable push-based ingestion. </strong>Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.</li> <li><strong>Connect to the lakehouse. </strong>Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.</li> <li><strong>Unblock infrastructure. </strong>Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.</li> <li><strong>Keep pipelines healthy. </strong>Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Close the loop with writebacks. </strong>Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.</li> <li><strong>Connect Celonis to AI. </strong>Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Identity, security, and governance:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own authentication and provisioning. </strong>Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.</li> <li><strong>Be the security translator. </strong>Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer and team impact:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Scope with confidence. </strong>Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.</li> <li><strong>Partner across teams. </strong>Serve as a technical point of contact for customer IT, data, and security stakeholders, and work closely with Value Engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, Partners, Support, and Product &amp; Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Be the voice of the field. </strong>Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Build reusable assets. </strong>Contribute reusable connector templates, scripts, runbooks, and best-practice documentation that scale across customers and partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as solutions engineering, integration or implementation consulting, data engineering, or technical consulting.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with REST APIs and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, tokens); comfort using tools like Postman to explore and test APIs.</li> <li>Solid programming skills in Python (or a similar language) and strong SQL skills.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data pipelines and ETL/ELT concepts, including incremental loads, scheduling, and handling large data volumes.</li> <li>Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.</li> <li>A basic understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TLS and certificates, proxies, firewalls, VPNs).</li> <li>The ability to explain technical topics clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and to manage your own workstreams across multiple customer projects.</li> <li>Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward solving problems hands-on.</li> <li>A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with SAP data structures, tables, or extraction (for example, RFC, ODP, or S/4HANA).</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.</li> <li>Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).</li> <li>Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.</li> <li>Experience with Docker or Linux server administration.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (for example, Celonis, cloud, or SAP certifications).</li> </ul><div title: Director of Product Design
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers. Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars. We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses. That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve. WHAT YOU'LL DO Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years. Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger. Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience. Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it. Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers. Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems. Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better. Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself. You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both. You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better. Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference. We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real. Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most. The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers. Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without. WHY CARWOW? Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 28 days annual leave 1 day for your wedding 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: <h3><strong>Introduction</strong></h3> <p>We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.</p> <p>This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.</p> <p>There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h3> <p>The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.</p> <p>You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.</p> <p>You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:</p> <ul> <li>First-principles engineering analysis</li> <li>Concept generation and the development of engineering designs</li> <li>Rapid prototyping</li> <li>Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes</li> <li>Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers</li> <li>Presenting results, both internally and to clients</li> <li>Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation</li> </ul> <p>Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.</p> <p>We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What you can bring</strong></h3> <p>You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.</p> <p>We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:</p> <ul> <li>An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience</li> <li>Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly</li> <li>A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery</li> <li>A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication</li> </ul> <p>In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):</p> <ul> <li>Experience in a consulting environment</li> <li>Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development</li> <li>Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA</li> <li>An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What we do</strong></h3> <p>Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)</li> <li>Company bonus (profit share)</li> <li>Flexible working patterns and hybrid working</li> <li>Medical insurance and group income protection</li> <li>Employee assistance programme and mental health support group</li> <li>Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li>Sabbatical leave</li> <li>Travel insurance (business and leisure)</li> <li>Generous company pension plan</li> <li>Personalised career development and training plans</li> <li>Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day</li> <li>Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links</li> <li>A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Why Cambridge Consultants?</strong></h3> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material. Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents. Collaborate with internal teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, to escalate and resolve complex safety cases. Help enforce Bumble Inc.’s policies by reviewing and processing accounts and content flagged for safety violations. Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, empathetic, and professional responses. Have experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcers (BPOs) to ensure quality and consistency in safety-related workflows (preferred). Are passionate about Bumble’s mission and values. Are empathetic, resilient, and comfortable working in emotionally challenging situations. Have a strong understanding of online safety issues and best practices in Trust & Safety. Are detail-oriented and able to balance efficiency with thoughtful decision-making. Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Benefits & Perks Annual personal learning & development budget Private Medical Insurance (PMI) Private Dental Insurance Babylon Health app Mental health support Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package Unlimited PTO Subsidised gym membership ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6% Premium App Access About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Inclusion at Bumble Inc. Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc). AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly. Fraudulent Candidate Detection Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Enforcement Appeals Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. We are seeking a highly motivated, hands-on candidate who thrives in a cross-functional environment and is excited to support the evolution of our Trust Operations team.

In this position, you will investigate and respond to members' appeals as a result of account restrictions and content moderation. You will help uphold Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines by reviewing and enforcing actions on violating accounts and content to maintain a safe and respectful environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with sensitive content, including child exploitation, graphic or physical sexual violence, suicide and self-harm, and other potentially distressing material.

Trust and safety are embedded in Bumble Inc.’s mission of creating a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable. Our wider Trust organization includes centralized and dedicated teams focused on:

  • Creating products and systems that proactively detect and prevent harm and promote healthy, kind relationships.

  • Developing policies that govern and adjudicate responsible, safe, inclusive, and respectful behaviour and content across all Bumble Inc. platforms.

  • Supporting members who experience safety incidents in a trauma-informed, empathetic manner.

This role will be based in London, UK reporting to the Enforcement Appeals Manager.

Please note: This position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and take action on members’ appeals for content removals, account bans, or other enforcement actions in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Provide high-touch, trauma-informed safety support to members who have experienced safety incidents.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, to escalate and resolve complex safety cases.

  • Help enforce Bumble Inc.’s policies by reviewing and processing accounts and content flagged for safety violations.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

About You

  • Have 2–4 years of experience in a Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, or content moderation role, preferably in a high-risk or safety-focused environment.

  • Have demonstrated ability to work with sensitive content and provide support in cases involving child exploitation, sexual violence, and self-harm.

  • Have experience handling high-touch safety escalations, particularly those involving vulnerable individuals.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, empathetic, and professional responses.

  • Have experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcers (BPOs) to ensure quality and consistency in safety-related workflows (preferred).

  • Are able to work independently, prioritize urgent tasks, and make sound judgment calls under pressure.

  • Have proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another second language (preferred).

  • Are passionate about Bumble’s mission and values.

  • Are empathetic, resilient, and comfortable working in emotionally challenging situations.

  • Have a strong understanding of online safety issues and best practices in Trust & Safety.

  • Are detail-oriented and able to balance efficiency with thoughtful decision-making.

  • Are comfortable working flexible hours to support global teams and participating in on-call shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. norms we're building from scratch — your ideas about how we do things will actually get heard and implemented Act as the connective tissue between our customers and Orbital’s Product, Engineering, and CS teams — making sure nothing falls through the cracks as we grow ✨ Who We’re Looking For We are open to a range of backgrounds. The common thread is: bright, proactive, and genuinely interested in real estate and AI. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our&nbsp;pioneering&nbsp;agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit &nbsp;<a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients.&nbsp;</p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction.&nbsp;</p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data &amp; technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: As a Revenue Operations Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping the CRM tidy; you are building the automated engine that tells our sellers which accounts matter and why. You will design Clay pipelines, enrichment workflows, and AI agents that surface the right accounts to sales and SDRs, and you will make sure they keep working long after launch. You own the GTM stack for our EMEA team, from Salesforce workflows to the integrations that tie HubSpot, Notion, and Slack together. As a Revenue Operations Engineer, your role will include: Account intelligence and enrichment: You will build and extend Clay tables, enrichment, and discovery pipelines that find new accounts and surface the right ones to sales and SDRs. You will push the tool well past its current setup and get the full value out of it. AI agents and automation: You will turn manual GTM workflows into automated ones using agents in Clay, Salesforce, and Claude. You build them to run end to end and stay useful, not to demo once and break a month later. Data quality that stays clean: You will design repeatable processes that keep account and contact data accurate over time. When a cleanup happens, it happens once, and the workflow behind it prevents the mess from coming back. Scoring and top-of-funnel signals: You will own account and MQL funnel scoring and the signal workflows that route intent to the right seller at the right time. Systems and integrations: You will build Salesforce workflows and maintain integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Momentum, Chili Piper, Notion, and Slack. When a new tool or feature beats what we built six months ago, you will make the call to replace it. EMEA RevOps support: You will own the RevOps ticket queue during EMEA hours, partnering with our US-based RevOps teammate for follow-the-sun coverage. That includes helping reps with live opportunity questions, not only systems work. This role could be a fit for you if you bring: Hands-on Clay experience: You have built Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, and pipelines yourself, and can explain what you would build next. Salesforce depth: You can build Salesforce flows and automation, not just run reports. HubSpot fluency is expected alongside it. AI-forward building: You have built AI agents or automations that run in production, using tools like Claude, Clay agents, or Salesforce automation, and you can show what they do today. Systems thinking for GTM: You understand how scoring, routing, enrichment, and CRM hygiene connect, and you design for the whole loop rather than one fix. EMEA-based and self-directed: You are based in EMEA, comfortable owning a queue without a teammate in your time zone, and you decide what to fix next without waiting to be told. Bonus points for: Salesforce Admin certification: Or equivalent admin-level experience owning an org. Code and CLI comfort: Experience with scripting, APIs, the Claude CLI, or MCP integrations. Startup scaling experience: You have helped a company grow from Series A toward later stage and built the systems that growth needed. Advanced Clay or Anthropic tooling: You are the person others ask when they want to know what Clay or Claude can actually do. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
